sub_graphs.title: Prague ECRECOVER: Signature Recovery Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the complete lifecycle of an ECRECOVER precompile call from input to address recovery

nodes.label: ECRECOVER Precompile Called
nodes.description: A CALL has been made to the ECRECOVER precompile at address 0x01

nodes.label: Read Call Data
nodes.description: Extract the 128 bytes of input data (message hash, v, r, s)

nodes.label: Input Data Read
nodes.description: The four 32-byte input parameters have been extracted from call data

nodes.label: Extract Signature Parameters
nodes.description: Parse message hash (bytes 0-31), v (bytes 32-63), r (bytes 64-95), s (bytes 96-127)

nodes.label: Parameters Extracted
nodes.description: Message hash, v, r, and s values are available for processing

nodes.label: Validate Signature Parameters
nodes.description: Validate v is 27 or 28, r and s are non-zero and less than SECP256K1N

nodes.label: Validation Failed
nodes.description: One or more signature parameters are invalid

nodes.label: Validation Passed
nodes.description: All signature parameters are valid

nodes.label: Recover Public Key
nodes.description: Call secp256k1_recover() to derive the public key from signature and hash

nodes.label: Recovery Failed
nodes.description: Public key recovery failed (InvalidSignatureError)

nodes.label: Public Key Recovered
nodes.description: The 64-byte public key has been successfully recovered

nodes.label: Derive Ethereum Address
nodes.description: Hash public key with Keccak256 and extract bytes 12-31 as the address

nodes.label: Address Derived
nodes.description: The 20-byte Ethereum address has been computed

nodes.label: Format Output
nodes.description: Left-pad the address to 32 bytes for EVM output

nodes.label: Output Ready
nodes.description: 32-byte output with left-padded address is ready

nodes.label: Return Empty Output
nodes.description: Return with no output data (validation or recovery failed)

nodes.label: ECRECOVER Complete
nodes.description: ECRECOVER execution finished, output (or empty) returned

external_entities.name: Calling Contract
external_entities.description: The contract or EOA that invoked the ECRECOVER precompile

sub_graphs.title: Prague ECRECOVER: Input Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation rules for ECRECOVER signature parameters

nodes.label: ECRECOVER Inputs Received
nodes.description: Raw input parameters (v, r, s) have been parsed

nodes.label: Check V Value
nodes.description: Verify that v equals 27 or 28 (recovery identifier)

nodes.label: V Value Invalid
nodes.description: v is neither 27 nor 28

nodes.label: V Value Valid
nodes.description: v is 27 or 28

nodes.label: Check R Range
nodes.description: Verify 0 < r < SECP256K1N

nodes.label: R Value Invalid
nodes.description: r is zero or >= SECP256K1N

nodes.label: R Value Valid
nodes.description: r is within valid range

nodes.label: Check S Range
nodes.description: Verify 0 < s < SECP256K1N

nodes.label: S Value Invalid
nodes.description: s is zero or >= SECP256K1N

nodes.label: S Value Valid
nodes.description: s is within valid range

nodes.label: All Parameters Valid
nodes.description: v, r, and s all pass validation checks

nodes.label: Validation Early Exit
nodes.description: Validation failed, return empty output

sub_graphs.title: Prague ECRECOVER: Security Boundaries
sub_graphs.description: Models the trust boundaries and security-relevant data flows in ECRECOVER

nodes.label: Untrusted Input Received
nodes.description: Raw signature data from caller, potentially malicious

nodes.label: Check Input Length
nodes.description: Verify input is at least 128 bytes (padded with zeros if shorter)

nodes.label: Validate Cryptographic Bounds
nodes.description: Ensure r and s are within the curve order to prevent malleability

nodes.label: Signature Malleability Checked
nodes.description: Signature parameters checked against known malleability vectors

nodes.label: Call Cryptographic Library
nodes.description: Invoke secp256k1_recover from trusted crypto library

nodes.label: Cryptographic Result
nodes.description: Result from cryptographic library (success or failure)

nodes.label: Hash Public Key
nodes.description: Apply Keccak256 to derive address (one-way transformation)

nodes.label: Trusted Output
nodes.description: Validated address ready for return to caller

external_entities.name: Calling Contract
external_entities.description: Contract providing signature data, treated as untrusted

ambiguities.text: The specific GAS_ECRECOVER value is not specified in this document
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the standard value of 3000 gas per EIP-150.

ambiguities.text: The behavior when input is less than 128 bytes is implied but not explicitly stated
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume input is zero-padded to 128 bytes when shorter, as is standard for precompile behavior.

ambiguities.text: Whether high-S values (s > SECP256K1N/2) are rejected is not explicitly stated
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume high-S values are NOT rejected at the precompile level (EIP-2 signature malleability fix is at transaction level, not precompile level).

implicit_assumptions.description: The secp256k1_recover cryptographic library is correctly implemented and secure
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Faulty recovery could allow signature forgery or return wrong addresses

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot find two different (r, s, v) tuples that recover to the same address for the same message hash
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Signature replay across different v values could be exploited

implicit_assumptions.description: Keccak256 is collision-resistant for deriving addresses from public keys
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Address collisions could allow impersonation attacks

implicit_assumptions.description: The precompile always returns empty output on any error rather than reverting
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Calling contracts may not properly handle revert vs empty return
